title: The Grand Tour
brief:
Twenty columns, three flags, and every kind of ground you have met so far.

You already have everything you need: a function that takes one smart step, and a loop that keeps taking them until the flags are gone. If your Smart Step solution was written well, it should solve this level unchanged.

That is the real lesson of this whole topic — code that describes a method rather than a particular map keeps working when the map changes.
